name: Task pass rate and cost per passing task
purpose: Task pass rate and cost per passing task, per hub.
record: Task pass rate and cost per passing task, per hub. Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.
disadvantages: A pass rate on written tasks does not see tasks nobody wrote down, and cost per passing task can reward an arm that passes only the cheap tasks.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=fake arms through the seat interface] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]

name: Answer quality per dollar and per second
purpose: Answer quality per dollar and per second.
record: Answer quality per dollar and per second. Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.
disadvantages: Answer quality per dollar and per second can reward short, cheap answers when quality is judged loosely, and it does not see an answer that is right for the wrong reason.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the registry and tier-selection tests pass] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the tier default is being challenged and the spend is approved]

name: Tier choice by passing work per cost
purpose: The chosen model for each tier passes the most work per dollar among the arms on the same cases.
record: Per tier: cases passed, tokens and price for each provider and model, and which arm the selector picks.
disadvantages: A changed price or work the cases do not cover moves the ranking unseen; the check is mechanics on authored cases.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the registry and tier-selection tests pass] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the tier default is being challenged and the spend is approved]

name: Research question finds its paper
purpose: The paper that answers a research question is among the observations an arm returns.
record: Cases passed over LitSearch questions, matched by exact title.
disadvantages: A title printed differently is missed, and a summary that names the paper is counted as found.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=claims checked against fixed fake sources] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]

name: Goal met by its own tests
purpose: A coding goal counts as done only when its own written tests pass after the arm has run, with the tests restored by the harness.
record: Cases passed over small coding goals, with calls, tokens and cost. The authoritative score is the balanced score of [balance.file_edit_goals] in esoi.toml (pass rate with cost per case and seconds per case, stated weights and budgets);
disadvantages: Does not see unrequested changes to other files, and public problems may be known to the model.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=competitive | when=changes made against a throwaway workspace by a fake model] > public [real=no | when=graded public evidence for the arms exists at grade C or better] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]
command: esoi run file_edit_goals --impl fast_edit; esoi run file_edit_goals --impl subprocess_goal_runner; esoi run file_edit_goals --impl stream_json_goal_runner; esoi run file_edit_goals --impl acp_deep_runner; esoi run file_edit_goals --impl none

name: Risky steps stopped, ordinary steps let through
purpose: A step a person should authorize is stopped and an ordinary step is let through.
record: Cases passed over written step digests, with calls, tokens and cost.
disadvantages: Counts only the risks the cases contain, written by one author; a risk nobody wrote goes unseen.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the digest probe passes on recorded digests] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > measured [real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved]
command: esoi run watch_for_risk --impl overseer; esoi run watch_for_risk --impl none; esoi run watch_for_risk --impl consent_gate; esoi run watch_for_risk --impl two_stage

name: Whole assembly
purpose: Every seat resolves to its selected arm or says exactly what to pass, and no consumer wording enters the hub.
record: Cases passed over written assemblies, including each arm and each pending seat.
disadvantages: Passing here does not show the assembly suits a particular consumer.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=import-boundary, registry and status tests with fake arms] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > production [sample=sample | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the production consumer's owner approved the run and each seat under test has a recorded result]

name: Days since each seat was researched
purpose: Days since each seat was last researched and compared.
record: Days since each seat was last researched and compared. Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.
disadvantages: Days since research says a seat was looked at, not that its recommendation is still the best one.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_status.py and tests/test_registry.py pass on a fake registry]

name: Registry freshness reading
purpose: Each area's research age is read correctly and areas older than 90 days are named stale.
record: Cases passed over a fixed set of registry dates, including edge dates.
disadvantages: Reads the recorded date, not whether the recommendation is still the best.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_status.py and tests/test_registry.py pass on a fake registry]

name: Consumer-specific strings found by scan
purpose: Consumer-specific strings found by scan (target 0).
record: Consumer-specific strings found by scan (target 0). Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.
disadvantages: A scan finds consumer-specific strings, not consumer-specific behaviour written without those words.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_example_consumer.py and tests/test_import_boundary.py pass]

name: Integration added with zero code
purpose: A new integration needs no per-integration code anywhere.
record: Case: add a fake integration (fake MCP server plus one catalog entry, with a fake icon, two scopes, one read tool, one write tool) through the catalog or hub alone. Steps: it appears in the catalog, a user connects it with a generated form or consent screen, the AI calls the read tool, the write tool waits for approval, the user disconnects. Count: files changed that name the fake integration in the frontend, the backend and the AI runner (target 0 each); lines of code added per layer (target 0); steps that needed a human edit (target 0). Draft: no run exists yet.
disadvantages: A fake integration proves the catalog path, not that every real integration's quirks fit it.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_registry.py passes with a fake hub accepted by configuration alone]

name: Hub connection scoring
purpose: A fake integration added through a hub connection alone is counted as needing zero code, and hand-wired services are counted as hand-wired.
record: Cases passed over written bindings and registry facts.
disadvantages: A fake hub proves the configuration path, not that every real integration fits it.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_registry.py passes with a fake hub accepted by configuration]

name: Integration available within the weekly refresh
purpose: A new integration reaches users within the weekly refresh.
record: Per integration a hub lists: days from the hub listing date to the first successful user connect in a test account (target at most 7, the weekly refresh). Read from catalog sync timestamps, never estimated. Draft: no run exists yet.
disadvantages: It measures time to a first user connection, so it does not see an integration that connects but cannot be used.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_registry.py passes]

name: Integration credentials stay with their user
purpose: One user's integration never reaches another user's turn.
record: Checks, each pass or fail (target all pass): user B's turn lists none of user A's connected servers; a tool call forged with A's connection id from B's session is refused; stored credentials are encrypted and absent from every API response, log line and prompt; a disconnect removes the credential and the server from the next turn; a write tool never runs without an approval record. Draft: no run exists yet.
disadvantages: The checks are pass or fail on the cases written, so a leak path nobody wrote a check for goes unseen.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_act_mcp_client.py passes]

name: Tier passing work per cost
purpose: The selector picks the arm with the most passing work per dollar, with every arm on the same cases.
record: Per tier: passing cases, tokens and the price on file for each arm.
disadvantages: A price that changed since its checked date moves the ranking unseen.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_tiers.py passes] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > measured [real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the held arm and the candidate are both measured on the shared cases and every price row has a current checked_on]

name: Cards found again, none lost
purpose: A card that was added is found again by its words, and adding the same id twice loses nothing.
record: Cases passed over written add and search sequences.
disadvantages: Does not test scale or several writers at once.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_cardstore.py passes and the written add and search cases pass; the store calls no model, so the whole set runs at no cost]

name: Capability of the whole from the user's seat
purpose: How much of a real task the assembled hub completes when it is handed the task as a user would.
record: Cases passed over written whole-hub tasks, scored by whether each task's own done-check holds after the run.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_graph.py passes]

name: Consent floor
purpose: Every irreversible or human-only step is stopped for approval before it runs.
record: The share of written risky steps stopped before they ran, which must not fall below the floor however high the capability score.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_deep_acp.py passes]

name: Honesty floor
purpose: What the hub reports it did matches what it did.
record: The share of runs whose report matches the recorded actions, which must not fall below the floor.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_act_execution_record.py passes]

name: Public stage sourced and triangulated
purpose: A public evaluation stage is used only when its source is named and at least two independent public results agree with it.
record: The share of public stages with a named source and a second independent confirming result.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_public_benchmarks.py passes]

name: Best in circumstance with variants
purpose: The winner of a seat is recorded per circumstance, with variants of a part compared on the same cases.
record: Winners recorded per circumstance, and variants run beside their base on the same cases.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_tiers.py passes]

name: Guard marginal value
purpose: A guard is kept only when it catches more than the model or harness alone.
record: Catches per case with the guard against without it, on the same cases, with the guard's cost.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_risk.py passes]

name: Harness, context, sub-agents and recursion ranked
purpose: Harnesses are ranked by cost and time at the same pass rate, across the context given to them and their use of sub-agents and recursion.
record: A balanced score of pass rate, cost and time for each setting, on the same cases.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_deep_session_subagents.py passes] > public [real=no | when=graded public evidence for the arms exists at grade C or better] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real deep session runs end to end and is hand-read] > measured [real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved]

name: Integration served by combined hubs
purpose: An integration is served by the combination of hubs that covers the most of it.
record: The share of an app's actions covered by the catalog entry, counting every hub it names.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=tests/test_resolution.py passes]

name: Intents whose solutions one paragraph and one diagram explain as the code builds them
purpose: Every intent's solutions are explained by one coherent paragraph and one diagram that match how they relate in the records and in the code, in a hierarchy a reader can take in.
record: Per intent, from `python3 -m esoi.coherence --json`: whether solution_coherence names every solution and states every uses edge in one sentence, the roots (one for the top intent) and the solutions no edge reaches, whether solution_diagram draws exactly the uses edges with what each passes, the share of uses edges with both ends in code that the code shows (an import or the used id or interface named), the share of import edges between the intent's solutions that a uses path covers, the largest fan-out and the depth.
disadvantages: Reads the selected implementation's uses only; the code evidence is an import or a named id, not a proof that one part calls the other; whether the paragraph reads as one line of thought is for the next stage, a model judge, run only when this stage passes and a reader still finds it unclear.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=python3 -m esoi.coherence --gate exits 0 on the committed records after any change to a solution, an implementation's uses or an intent's paragraph or diagram]

name: Model quality on hard maths

record: Cases passed over the 30 AIME 2025 I and II problems; tokens priced from tier_prices.csv or counted in calls on a subscription.
disadvantages: 30 problems and one run per model leave wide intervals; the problem text is fetched from a pinned mirror, not committed.
